svg.title: The width of 64 cut into 4 heads of 16: each head its own slice of the queries, keys and values and its own weights over the window; the same four Linear layers, 16,640 weights, either way
svg.text: one position's query, 64 numbers (its key and value are cut the same way)
each head's own weights over the window (block 1 of the page's 4-block model, seed 0)
each head scores, masks and sums on its own, its scores divided by sqrt(16) = 4;
the 4 results, side by side again, are 64 numbers, and out mixes them
one head over all 64: the same query, key, value and out layers, 16,640 weights; 4 heads: 16,640
